design.summary: A generator in the dev repo computes each skill's closure, bundles it (and deps) with esbuild into dist/*.mjs, rewrites SKILL.md and resources for a per-skill install, assembles a dedicated publish tree, and pushes it to a new public repo; skills.sh indexes it after a telemetry install.

discoveredRequirements.requirement: New root scripts must be oxfmt/oxlint --deny-warnings clean; unstaged-guard requires staging
Adding esbuild requires lockfile regen; make install uses --frozen-lockfile and OSV scans lockfiles
Tracked .agents artifacts must be indexed under their section in .agents/README.md or the gate fails
Do not use GitHub's Node .gitignore in the publish repo (it excludes dist)
Nested .agents/test/docs exist inside skill dirs and must be excluded recursively

constraints: Each skill must install alone and run (no ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND)
No minification; keep instruction wording unchanged
No secrets in any published artifact
The dev repo's live OpenCode install must keep working
deliverables: Corrected dev repo with a green gate and 14 discoverable skills
Public repo jamiemills/csm-skills with install content and per-skill metadata
Written proof that all 14 install and run
skills.sh listing seeded, audits captured, optional Vercel Pack
